entities.name: Aeric Valenheart
entities.description: First person to fall into the natural pocket dimension in 1354 AD, surviving by intellect, sigils, and glimmer-sense while barely aging due to slower time.
entities.quote: Aeric Valenheart (1300s era) First person in history to fall into the natural pocket dimension. Vanished in 1354 AD. Time inside flows MUCH slower → he barely ages. Lives by intellect, sigils, glimmer-sense.

entities.name: Marcello Corvani
entities.description: A former ECAP operative who quit and was trapped in the pocket dimension in 2005 around age 35–38, losing an eye in a fight with Alt David.
entities.quote: Marcello Corvani (2005 era) Second known man to be trapped there. Trapped around age 35–38. He and Aeric meet inside the pocket dimension

entities.name: Victor
entities.description: Became ECAP Chairperson following his son's death, described as gentle and moral but too soft to stop Stitch's radical shift.
entities.quote: Victor becomes ECAP Chairperson Gentle, moral, but too soft to stop Stitch's radical shift.

entities.name: Stitch
entities.description: Left ECAP to join DEW in anger after Victor's son died, believing heroes must be controlled, and later tortured Ethan.
entities.quote: Stitch leaves ECAP and joins DEW in anger He thinks heroes MUST be controlled now.

entities.name: Alt David
entities.description: An unstable, traumatized dagger specialist with access to cube energy traces who accidentally fell into the pocket dimension and took Corvani's eye.
entities.quote: Alt David = dagger specialist Pocket dimension = low light, shifting terrain Corvani = defensive instincts but exhausted Alt David’s signature move → go for the eye.

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: Trapped in the pocket dimension for centuries, holding shared ancient knowledge of hidden realms, Hisham's death, Khalid's betrayal, and the ancient war.
entities.quote: Zaan has been trapped for centuries. Aeric connects with him through shared ancient knowledge. Corvani sees his entire worldview shattered.

entities.name: Ethan Thorne
entities.description: Imprisoned, starved, and tortured by Stitch until awakening as Elizah, breaking out of a cell, falling into the ocean, and being rescued by Corvani and Aeric.
entities.quote: Ethan Thorne Future leader of the Sentinels The person whose life will eventually connect ALL of their fates

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: An individual capable of sensing abnormal energy.
entities.quote: A rift opens. Nyxia senses abnormal energy.

entities.name: Zayn
entities.description: An individual present during a rift opening who cautiously steps back.
entities.quote: Nyxia senses abnormal energy. Zayn steps back cautiously.

entities.name: Hisham
entities.description: A figure from the timeline whose death is part of the ancient war history recounted by Zaan.
entities.quote: Zaan opens up about the timeline, including Hisham’s death → Khalid’s betrayal → the ancient war.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: A figure who committed a betrayal in the ancient war and has an impending confrontation with Zaan.
entities.quote: Zaan opens up about the timeline, including Hisham’s death → Khalid’s betrayal → the ancient war.

entities.name: ECAP
entities.description: An organization formerly chaired by Victor, previously associated with Stitch and Marcello Corvani before their departures in 2005.
entities.quote: 2005 is the Year of Collapse for the old ECAP era. ✔ Victor’s son dies (power-casualty incident) → Victor crumbles emotionally → Stitch snaps ideologically

entities.name: DEW
entities.description: An organization that Stitch joined after departing ECAP in anger.
entities.quote: Stitch leaves ECAP and joins DEW in anger He thinks heroes MUST be controlled now.

entities.name: Sentinels
entities.description: An organization whose future leader is Ethan Thorne.
entities.quote: Ethan Thorne Future leader of the Sentinels The person whose life will eventually connect ALL of their fates

timeline_events.title: Aeric Valenheart Vanishes into the Pocket Dimension
timeline_events.description: Aeric Valenheart becomes the first person in history to fall into the natural pocket dimension.
timeline_events.quote: Aeric Valenheart (1300s era) First person in history to fall into the natural pocket dimension. Vanished in 1354 AD.

timeline_events.title: Collapse of the Old ECAP Era and Corvani's Disappearance
timeline_events.description: Victor's son dies, Stitch leaves for DEW, Victor assumes the ECAP chair, and Corvani quits before being pulled into a spatial fracture while investigating Orion's lost team.
timeline_events.quote: 2005 is the Year of Collapse for the old ECAP era. ✔ Victor’s son dies (power-casualty incident) → Victor crumbles emotionally → Stitch snaps ideologically

timeline_events.title: Escape from the Pocket Dimension and Rescue of Ethan
timeline_events.description: Corvani and Aeric escape the pocket dimension into the ocean, where Corvani summons the whale to save a falling Ethan Thorne.
timeline_events.quote: Corvani & Aeric ESCAPE the Pocket Dimension in 2025
